decisions: Keep three land and two water individuals in separate validated M5 domains; do not teleport across the vertical coping.

Only in the close penguin colony view, schedule short randomized species-appropriate sequences with quiet intervals. Sample at most two visible rigs, including manual reactions; disable autonomy when leaving. Other species keep explicit tap behavior.

Open the colony/pool reference view directly from the map. A body tap moves closer to that individual; the selected swimmer is followed. A text-free ring identifies the observed animal and other automatic reactions settle. No default individual is implied at colony entry.

Retapping a watched swimmer extends swimming without resetting position or clip phase. Keep source water domains and the existing shared reflection pass; improve body readability with a 6 cm presentation offset rather than extra water effects.
Respect reduced-motion preference by suppressing autonomous scheduling while keeping explicit user-requested actions available.
Use source Sit1 and Sleep poses for a gradual sleep/wake sequence, not an invented source transition clip.
Sample only active rigs; preserve independent skeletons and shared geometry/materials/textures.
Bake blended skin grounding offline. Do not scan mesh vertices in the animation frame loop.
Render dirtiness and idle CPU/GPU behavior are different; verify actual frame count rather than infer savings from animation update CPU alone.
Keep physical-phone FPS and energy savings unclaimed until measured on that device.
